module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Value of $n$-th cyclotomic polynomial at $n$

The sequence $a(n) = \Phi_n(n)$ gives the value of the $n$-th cyclotomic polynomial evaluated
at $n$:
$$a(n) = |\Phi_n(n)|$$

*References:*
- [A070518](https://oeis.org/A070518)-/

@[expose] public section

namespace OeisA70518

open Polynomial

/-- Value of the $n$-th cyclotomic polynomial at $n$. -/
noncomputable def a (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((cyclotomic n ℤ).eval (n : ℤ)).natAbs

/-- Value of the sequence `a` at 1. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_1 : a 1 = 0 := by
  dsimp [a]
  rw [cyclotomic_one]
  simp

/-- Value of the sequence `a` at 2. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_2 : a 2 = 3 := by
  dsimp [a]
  rw [cyclotomic_two]
  simp

/-- Value of the sequence `a` at 3. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_3 : a 3 = 13 := by
  dsimp [a]
  have : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩
  rw [cyclotomic_prime ℤ 3]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]

/-- Value of the sequence `a` at 5. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_5 : a 5 = 781 := by
  dsimp [a]
  have : Fact (Nat.Prime 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
  rw [cyclotomic_prime ℤ 5]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]

open scoped Classical in
/--
$a(28341)$ is divisible by $283411^2$. What is the next $n$ such that $a(n)$ is not squarefree?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem conjecture :
    answer(sorry) =
      if h : ∃ n, 28341 < n ∧ ¬ Squarefree (a n) then
        some (sInf {n | 28341 < n ∧ ¬ Squarefree (a n)})
      else
        none := by
  sorry

end OeisA70518

reformulations.difference: The source asks for the next index after 28341 with a nonsquarefree term. Lean represents the answer by an Option ℕ: a guarded sInf gives some least index, and none means that no such index exists.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: For S = {n : ℕ | 28341 < n ∧ ¬ Squarefree (a n)}, nonemptiness ensures that sInf S belongs to S and is no larger than any other member. Thus some k is the answer exactly when k is the least qualifying index; none is the answer exactly when every later term is squarefree. The empty-set default sInf ∅ = 0 is never returned. The scratch theorem source_answer_iff proves the complete casewise equivalence for an arbitrary Option ℕ answer, including the equivalence between squarefreeness of a n and of the integer cyclotomic evaluation.

sources_consulted: OEIS A070518, revision #27 (20 August 2026), read through the official data mirror: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oeis/oeisdata/main/seq/A070/A070518.seq
Math.StackExchange answers by Peter and Andrea Marino: https://api.stackexchange.com/2.3/questions/3986249/answers?site=math&filter=withbody&pagesize=100

Tom Adamczewski, OEIS Open: How many conjectures can language models turn into theorems?, arXiv:2608.11941v2, Appendix A, A070518 entry. LaTeX source: https://arxiv.org/e-print/2608.11941; abstract and version history: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11941
review.notes: Checked the definition and all five theorems. The four recorded values match the OEIS b-file. Lean checks in /workspace/review/scratch.lean also establish a(0)=1 and additional values at 4, 6, 8, and 9. For n≥1, cyclotomic evaluation is nonnegative, so natAbs preserves the source's value; the extension at zero cannot affect the conjecture's strict lower bound. The scratch file compiles, and its equivalence proofs have no sorry dependencies. The paper linked from OEIS proves only the already-known divisibility at n=28341, not the next-index problem, so it does not warrant a status change. Direct OEIS entry pages were blocked; the official data mirror and b-file were accessible.
